auth_details: Free API key required on every Census Data API data query as query param key=YOUR_API_KEY. Signup free at api.census.gov/data/key_signup.html (approved email domains). No unauthenticated access.
free_tier_limits: Free API key required for every query; up to 50 variables per query; no paid API plan.
rate_limits: Up to 50 variables per query. Official docs publish no fixed requests-per-day quota; API key required for all data queries (former 500/day unauth limit is obsolete).
resolution_notes: auth.details: AUDITOR RIGHT. Official Query Limits (May 2026) state an API key must be used with all data queries: https://www.census.gov/data/developers/guidance/api-user-guide.Query_Limits.html ; confirmed https://www.census.gov/library/video/2026/adrm/requesting-a-census-data-api-key.html and PDF guide https://www2.census.gov/data/api-documentation/api-user-guide.pdf . free_tier_limits: AUDITOR RIGHT (placeholder); free key + 50-var limit + no paid plan per same sources and API Key page https://www.census.gov/data/developers/guidance/api-user-guide.API_Key.html . rate_limits: AUDITOR RIGHT; only published limit is 50 variables/query; no new day quota published.
